title: A fake 'Privacy Mode — Local storage encryption' toggle advertises a security feature that does not exist
detail: The control is a styled div with no onClick, no state and no backing implementation, rendered permanently in the on position. Nothing in the codebase encrypts anything. In a public repo this reads as a deliberate false security claim, and it is the first thing anyone auditing the project will find. It is also not a button, not focusable, and has no role=switch.

title: editedProfile snapshots the profile once and never resyncs, so saving reverts concurrent changes
detail: useState(profile) captures the value at mount. ThemeToggle writes the theme straight to the profile, so if the user changes theme while Edit Profile is open, pressing Save writes the stale snapshot back and silently reverts it. Switching profiles while editing has the same effect.

title: The 'Monthly Goal' card measures lifetime totals, not the month
detail: finishedCount counts every Finished book in the library with no date filter, so the ring only ever climbs and hits 100% permanently. Nothing writes finishedAt (S024, S042), so there is currently no data with which to make it monthly even if the filter existed.

title: handleExport hand-rolls the download helper the file already imports
detail: downloadText is imported and used at line 93, then lines 99-107 re-implement it — createObjectURL, anchor, append, click, remove, revoke — just to change the MIME type. downloadText already takes a mimeType argument.

title: Both export paths swallow failures silently
detail: handleExportMarkdown is invoked as void handleExportMarkdown() and neither it nor handleExport has a try/catch. A rejection from buildExport produces an unhandled rejection and no user-facing feedback — the button simply does nothing.

title: The selected voice chip is invisible in dark mode
detail: bg-stone-900 text-white sits on a dark:bg-gray-900 card, so the active selection is a near-black chip on a near-black surface. The unselected chips are legible, which makes the active one look missing rather than selected.

title: Danger Zone, Privacy card, export buttons and the goal ring track are all light-only
detail: bg-rose-50/border-rose-100/text-rose-900/text-rose-700, bg-blue-50/text-blue-600, bg-stone-100/text-stone-700 (x2), stroke-gray-50 on the progress ring, border-orange-100 on the bio quote, and both import status states carry no dark variants. Twelve sites in this file alone.

title: VOICES duplicates the VoiceName union and can drift from it silently
detail: A hand-maintained array that must match the type declared in types.ts. Adding a voice to the union compiles fine and simply never appears in the picker.

title: A monthlyGoal of 0 renders the ring as 100% complete
detail: Division by zero yields Infinity, which Math.min clamps to 100. The range input enforces min=1, but a migrated legacy profile can carry 0.

title: Reset All fires onResetLibrary with no confirmation at this level
detail: The most destructive control in the app is a single click here; whether it is guarded depends entirely on what the parent passes in.
